3yrs ago I stopped fangirling. The worst decision I’ve ever made and regretted the most. I entered into a relationship that I thought would last. I really thought it was true love. Imagine the sacrifice, giving up my fangirling life which I invested a lot just for an a**hole 🤡🤡

My friends are not into kpop but they supported me. I stopped going out with them because all my time and all my life were spent into this guy. My friends respected that decision of mine and they distanced themselves from me. I’m so stupid that I didn’t even noticed that before.

Months and even a year has passed, we were so inlove with each other. I even forgot about kpop 🤦‍♀️ We were legal, our families knew about us and so I thought it was an assurance that we will never break up. (I was wrong about that 🙄)

And just October last year, when supposed to be our 2nd anniversary, I found out he was cheating on me. He had a girl in the same school with him. What’s even worst? I found out on the day of our anniversary. Such an a**hole.

I got so crazy, I begged him, I went after him, I did everything to get him back. But he still chose the girl over me. I got stressed from that happening, plus that time my lola whose the only person I have, got hospitalized. I was really depressed.

I skipped school to forget all the stressful things, I always cry at night, my grades dropped and worst, my lola died. I was so lost, like I don’t know what’s happening, why does it have to be at the same time that I lost two of the most important person in my life.
Di pwede OT23 na sg? We’re broke
